name: Armadillo
flavour: Built like a helmet. Walks like one.
art_prompt: a chunky desert armadillo walking on four stubby clawed legs, a big domed shell of overlapping sandy brown armour bands with darker seams, a long pointed snout, small beady black eyes, big upright pointed ears, a thick banded armoured tail, cute but tough, standing on the ground, not rolled up
motion: trotting in place on four short stubby legs like on a treadmill, the domed armoured shell bobbing, the tail swaying
back_hint: Seen from behind: the domed banded shell, the thick armoured tail and the two big ears poking up over it, no face visible.
dead_hint: lying on its back on the ground, dead: the four little legs sticking up in the air, eyes shut, the banded shell underneath it
doc: Arrives in the second half of stage 1 in packs of six like the goblins, but armoured: twenty HP and it takes a quarter less from everything, slower than a goblin and harder to cut down, so a pack of them holds a line while the fodder dies around it. Counts as half a creature against the crowd cap.
